main_text.head: Idem aliter.
main_text.l: Io Sareí,& Saria státo O ego fuissem.
colúi Sarébbe,& faria státo ille fuisset.
main_text.head: Futurum subiunctiui.
main_text.l: Io Sáro státo quum ego fuero.
main_text.head: Infinit.mod.temp.præs.
Præt.

page.notes: Several Latin forms are set in italic and some letters are worn; "Saréte" and "Sarégti" are doubtful readings. The Greek-style accents on verb forms are reproduced as printed where legible.
